## Use case

What problem would this solve, and for whom?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior and a concrete example.

## Alternatives

What workarounds or alternative designs have you considered?

## Compatibility and safety

Does this affect supported protocols, sing-box versions, routing defaults,
subscription handling, secrets, or network exposure?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I described the problem, not only a preferred implementation.
- [ ] My example contains no real credentials or personal identifiers.
